name: Gradaly v3.0.0
title: Gradaly v3.0.0
notes:
### 🚀 Highlights & Improvements (v3.0.0)

- **Collaborative Project Sharing (.gradaly & Encrypted Cloud Links)**: Share full or partial grading projects with colleagues via `.gradaly` archives or end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM) Cloud share links (`#k=...`) with real-time progress bars.
- **Safe Import & Selective Per-Question Merge**: Import any shared archive as an independent new project (with custom name) or selectively merge rubrics and/or gradings per question into an existing compatible project (verified via SHA-256 canvas fingerprint) with automatic pre-merge backup and conflict protection.
